concept_id.description: Related curriculum concept ID, if any.

confirmed_by_learner.description: True only if the learner explicitly confirmed the commitment as read back.

description.description: The commitment in the learner's words, specific and measurable.

due_local.description: When it is due in the learner's local time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. 2026-10-05T21:00.

description: Save one specific commitment the learner has explicitly agreed to, such as "solve two graph problems by 9 PM". Only call it after you have read the commitment back and the learner has said yes. Use it for the learner's own promises, not your suggestions.
name: log_commitment
